classification_rationale: The customer is asking for a specific 25% discount on a long-term hire before committing, which is a price negotiation rather than something a published policy already settles.

draft.reply_body:
Hello,

Thank you for considering Haapaharju for your three-month excavator hire, and for your continued business with us.

I'm not able to offer a 25% discount. Our maximum discretionary discount, even at the most senior level, is capped at 15% of the list rate — anything above that has to go to management for a decision. I'm passing this request on and will come back to you once we have an answer.

In the meantime, if you can confirm the exact excavator model and the dates you have in mind, we can start putting together a formal quote at the list rate as a baseline.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
